name: Snooze Until Free
description: Snooze a conversation until the next real gap in your calendar, so it comes back when you can actually deal with it.
author: mach <plugins@example.com>

actions.title: Snooze until I'm free
actions.summary: Hide the conversation until the next gap of at least 45 minutes in the user's working hours, then return it to the inbox.

params.name: minimumMinutes
params.description: How long a gap has to be to count. Defaults to 45.
